description.value: Julie Anne's has been a Chilliwack creative institution since 1984, combining a well-stocked art supply shop — carrying brands such as Golden, Fabriano, Van Gogh, and Heinz Jordan — with a custom framing service and a working gallery. The store also hosts drop-in art classes led by local artists covering acrylics, watercolour, drawing, and mixed media, making it a genuine community arts hub rather than a simple retail stop. A cycling tourist with artistic inclinations could browse original works, stock up on supplies, or join a Saturday morning drop-in class.
